rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something begins impressively but ends weakly or without a satisfying climax.

example.english: The movie began impressively, but the ending was anticlimactic.
example.traditional: 套戲開頭氣勢磅礴，點知結局虎頭蛇尾。
example.jyutping: tou3 hei3 hoi1 tau4 hei3 sai3 pong4 bok6 dim2 zi1 git3 guk6 fu2 tau4 se4 mei5

rows.jyutping: leoi4 sing1 daai6 jyu5 dim2 siu2
rows.note: Use this when the buildup, claims, or apparent importance are great but the actual result is disappointingly small.

example.english: They made a huge fuss at the new product launch, but in the end they only released a small feature; it was really anticlimactic.
example.traditional: 嗰個新產品發布會講到天花龍鳳，最後只係推出一個小功能，真係雷聲大雨點小。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 san1 caan2 ban2 faat3 bou3 wui2 gong2 dou3 tin1 faa1 lung4 fung6 zeoi3 hau6 zi2 hai6 teoi1 ceot1 jat1 go3 siu2 gung1 nang4 zan1 hai6 leoi4 sing1 daai6 jyu5 dim2 siu2

rows.note: Use this broader choice when the ending or event is simply disappointing and takes the excitement out of the situation.

example.english: It suddenly rained while we were having fun, which was really anticlimactic.
example.traditional: 大家玩得正開心，突然落大雨，真係掃興。
